# A seabed rock 1.1 m, plum with a rose top. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.451 0.275 0.298 --no-slot
material new Top --base-color 0.671 0.337 0.459 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.55 --location 0 0 0.2 --rotation 15 25 40
scale 1.3 1 0.9
apply --scale
material assign Rock
active Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
material assign Top
mode object
shade flat
export rock.glb
